procedure: Select relevant writing profile and permitted conclusion strength.
Connect evidence, judgment, alternatives and consequences.
Preserve bound metrics and review limits.
Return content and unsupported claims to their analytical owner.

acceptance.expectation: Prose develops a supported decision argument without converting proposals or scenarios into facts.
Material claims, numbers and dates have current bindings.
Formats and actual rendering/review limits remain explicit.

conditions: Required input unavailable or hash/version stale
Acceptance is failed or not performed
failure.record: failure_records with affected record, missing evidence/test, consequence, owner, next action and interim conclusion restriction
